newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Borough of Rockleigh, N.J.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Borough of Rockleigh, N.J.

text.p: SEALED PROPOSALS will be received by the Borough Council of the Borough of Rockleigh, in the County of Bergen, New Jersey at the Municipal Building, 26 Rockleigh Road,
until 8:00 p.m. for the above Bonds due (without option of prior redemption) on May 15 as follows:

The Bonds will be issued in book-entry form only, in the form of one certificate for the aggregate principal amount of each series of the Bonds maturing in each year. The Borough will furnish the Bonds and the approving legal opinion of McManimon & Scotland, Newark, N.J. The Bonds will bear a single rate of interest per annum in multiples of 1/8 or 1/20 of 1% specified by the successful bidder payable on November 15, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on May 15 and November 15 in each year until maturity. The Bonds will be awarded to the bidder specifying the lowest rate of interest in accordance with the terms set forth in the full Notice of Sale. The full Notice of Sale, the Official Statement and bid forms are available by contacting contacting Lou-Anne
Horsey, Administrator, 26 Rockleigh Road, Rockleigh, New Jersey 07647.
